name: Mythological Goddess (Niamh Devine)
reason: Health rule: her own site (niamhdevine.com, read 5 Nov 2026) is framed around physical healing: it leads with healing paralysis, a course on what physical symptoms are communicating, mentoring sold on becoming pain-free and moving from illness to health, and its shop items are chakra transmissions "for Physical Health". Almost nothing passes the strict health-claim rule beyond an Ireland pilgrimage and one workshop. Owner may wish to review (pilgrimage and a core-values workshop on 15 Nov would pass).
